title: greengrass#component
description: Add an AWS IoT Greengrass component to an existing Python or TypeScript project. Language is inferred from the selected project's marker when unambiguous.

project.description: The existing Python or TypeScript host project
project.x-prompt: Select the project to add the Greengrass component to

name.x-prompt: What name would you like for the Greengrass component?

language.description: The component language. Omit it only when the host has exactly one supported language marker.

componentName.description: The recipe ComponentName. Defaults to a reversed-domain name derived from the workspace npm scope and component name.

componentVersion.description: The recipe ComponentVersion. CDK resolves NEXT_* at deploy time; Terraform requires an explicit semantic version. With infra=none, NEXT_* is written unchanged.

publisher.description: The recipe ComponentPublisher. Defaults to the workspace npm scope.

ipc.description: Whether to wire the Greengrass IPC client. Defaults to false for both languages.

gdkConfig.description: Vend gdk-config.json for using the GDK CLI by hand. GDK supports NEXT_PATCH, not NEXT_MINOR or NEXT_MAJOR.

platform.description: The core device platform or platforms.
platform.x-prompt: Which core device platform(s) would you like to target?

infra.description: component-version vends reusable Greengrass component infrastructure; none supports local development only.
infra.x-prompt: Which infrastructure would you like to provision?

iac.description: The IaC provider, resolved only when infrastructure is requested.
iac.x-prompt: Which provider would you like to manage your infrastructure? (default: Inherit)

preferInstallDependencies.description: Whether to prefer installing dependencies after the generator runs.
